entities.summary: The Darnytskyi Automobile and Railway Bridge Crossing, known colloquially as the New Darnytskyi Bridge or Kirpa Bridge, is a combined road and railroad bridge in Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine. It spans across the Dnieper River connecting the left and right banks of the city, the Darnytsia and Holosiiv districts of Kyiv, respectively. The bridge carries a double track rail line and is built to accommodate six lanes of road traffic.
